@ffmpeg/core 0.12.10 and @ffmpeg/core-mt 0.12.10
WebAssembly build of FFmpeg, including third-party codecs and filters.
This component is not covered solely by the wrapper's MIT license.
FFmpeg / x264 / x265 and other components retain their respective licenses.
GPL version 2 text: licenses/FFmpeg-GPLv2.txt
Core source and build project: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/71aa99d37c02a7b4c435275ca9ef50e612f6efa1
FFmpeg source: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/n5.1.4
Upstream component list and licensing notes:
https://ffmpegwasm.netlify.app/docs/overview/
https://ffmpegwasm.netlify.app/docs/faq/

The unmodified @ffmpeg/core and @ffmpeg/core-mt 0.12.10 binaries are
GPL-2.0-or-later and share the corresponding source/build project above.
Corresponding source archives, original license/copyright notices, pinned
checksums, and build instructions are available without registration at:
  https://atsushisakai.github.io/Maitake/sources/
These sources include the upstream release build scripts, codec libraries,
Emscripten runtime source, SDL, and the zimg test submodule. Original
licenses and notices remain inside each source archive.
